column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (copying error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): Siege of Towers' 2024-01-12 replicate ruling says the trigger copies 'Shattering Spree', but Siege of Towers' replicate copies Siege of Towers ('When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost.'). The Ravnica Remastered Release Notes (Eric Levine, 2023-12-13) have the same note with the card's own name, 'you'll copy Siege of Towers for each time you paid its replicate cost' (read in work item web-research-1, Nov 20); Gatherer's text is Shattering Spree's ruling of the same day, word for word with the name left unchanged. The rest of the ruling agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_siege_of_towers_replicate.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
